_comment: Confirmed (instrument, file, line_hash) occurrences for every currently-baselined unresolved pointer instrument in sc_pointer_baseline.json. sc_pointer_validation.ts requires every live unresolved-pointer hit for a baselined instrument to also appear here — this is the Ring-2 fix (post-bacade1c) that stops a name-only baseline from silently absorbing a brand-new pointer occurrence to an already-known-bad instrument name. EMPTY since 2026-07-30 (SAMĀPTI lane A2) because sc_pointer_baseline.json is empty: with zero tolerated unresolved instruments there is nothing to record occurrences for. The SC-pointer:occurrence-freshness check FAILS on any entry here that no longer matches a live hit, so this ledger can never drift ahead of the tree the way it did between 2026-07-10 and 2026-07-30 (it still listed production sites in registry_bridge.ts / register_d9_judgment.ts / register_p1_ganita.ts / register_d10_pact.ts weeks after those pointers were fixed).
